Scene.CreateHint: Creates a dark, gridless scene with vision and fog switched off. Drop Actors onto it, or use Cast on the toolbar, then bind them together.
Scene.Name: Scene name

Welcome.Title: Vampire Relationships
Welcome.Body: This world has no relationship map yet. Create one now? You can always make another later from the Scenes sidebar or the module settings.

Notify.NothingToArrange: Place at least two characters on the map before arranging it.
Notify.Arranged: Arranged {count} characters. To put them back: Arrange, then Undo last arrange.
Notify.BondNeedsTwo: Choose who is bound: a bond needs a character at each end.
Notify.BondSelf: A character cannot be bound to themselves.
Notify.BondFailed: The bond could not be saved. See the console for details.
Notify.CastNone: Tick at least one character to add.
Notify.LayoutLocked: The layout is locked. Unlock it from Appearance on the map toolbar.
Notify.PlayersCannotMove: Only the Storyteller can rearrange this map.

Toolbar.Subtitles: Details under names: rank, clan, covenant, coterie
Toolbar.Fit: Fit the map to the screen

Arrange.Title: Arrange
Arrange.AutoHint: Untangles the web by its bonds and sets the unattached in rows beneath. Keeps outlined groups together.
Arrange.CovenantHint: Auto layout, with every covenant on ground of its own.
Arrange.ClanHint: Auto layout, with every clan on ground of its own.
Arrange.LineageHint: Sires above, childer below, line by line.
Arrange.SelectionHint: With two or more tokens selected, only those are arranged.
Arrange.CoterieHint: Auto layout, with every coterie on ground of its own.

ViewAs.Title: See as
ViewAs.NoPlayers: No player accounts in this world yet.

Filters.Title: Filters
Filters.Hint: Filters only change what you see.

Appearance.Title: Appearance
Appearance.HoverFocusHint: Lights the bonds of the character under the pointer and steps the rest back.
Appearance.BackdropHint: A faint dot grid and haze behind the map.
Appearance.Shared: These choices are saved on the scene and shared with every player.
Appearance.RankHint: The Rank box on the sheet's Vampire tab, in gold capitals.
Appearance.CoterieHint: The Coterie box on the sheet.

Bond.ShowArrowHint: Marks the direction from the first character to the second.
Bond.Label: Label (optional)
Bond.LabelHint: A short descriptor shown on the line.
Bond.PublicNotesPlaceholder: What players know about this bond.
Bond.PublicNotesHint: Shown to every player who can see the bond.
Bond.KeyTieHint: Marks one of the most important ties.
Bond.DeleteBody: Sever this bond for good? This cannot be undone.

Visibility.SpecificHint: Hidden, except from the players you pick.
Visibility.NoPlayers: There are no player accounts to choose from yet.
Visibility.Rule: A player only ever sees a bond when they can also see the characters at both ends.

Dossier.Title: Dossier
Dossier.SecretSome: Only some players see this bond
Dossier.UnlinkedHint: This token keeps its own copy of the character sheet. The map shows that copy: open the sheet from the token to change it. Edits made to the Actor in the sidebar only show here for boxes the copy has not changed.

Cast.Title: Add to the Cast
Cast.Empty: Every Actor in this world is already on the map.
Cast.TiesHint: Bonds already recorded for this character

CreateMap.Name: Relationship map
CreateMap.Label: Create a relationship map
CreateMap.Hint: Creates a new scene set up as a relationship map. An existing scene can be converted from its right-click menu in the Scenes sidebar.

MinLevel.Name: Ownership needed to see a character
MinLevel.Hint: A player sees a character on the map only when they hold at least this ownership level on its Actor. Storytellers always see everyone.

DefaultBond.Name: New bonds are visible to
DefaultBond.Hint: The starting audience for a newly created bond. Either way, a bond stays hidden from a player who cannot see both of its characters.

PlayersMove.Name: Players may rearrange the map
PlayersMove.Hint: When off, only Storytellers can drag characters around a relationship map.

DossierOnSelect.Name: Open the dossier on select
DossierOnSelect.Hint: Selecting a single character on a relationship map opens the panel listing their ties.

NewBond.Name: New bond
NewBond.Hint: On a relationship map, start a bond from the selected token (or between two selected tokens).
